# Synthetic retrospective navigation fixtures

Both HTML files are wholly synthetic test material. They contain no copied article prose, actual individuals, household circumstances, or real source URLs. The example.org/example.net links are reserved example-domain citations, not evidence of real events.

The fixtures preserve the markup contract under test: a Food Line root card with an explicit limited-retrospective label and date range, a matching local route, target publication-type label, limited-edition disclaimer, and two separately dated article/source-attribution pairs. Dates are test inputs, not claims that events occurred.

These tests verify navigation, calendar consistency, document type and visibility behavior only. Real retained-baseline validation is separate private evidence and is not included in this fixture package. Passing these tests grants no editorial approval, source approval or publication authority.
